scenario: A chained exponent `t.a ** t.b ** 2` is accepted by the arithmetic productions (LGRA.9.5.1) and type-checks under LEXP.7.3a. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: either grouping compiles, so `compile_ok` cannot observe right-associativity; see LEXP.7.3a.json for the chained-runtime-exponent rejection.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t where (t.a ** t.b ** 2) > 0
->
    log info "x"
